name: WARNING: Red Lentil Penne & Pulse Pastas (High FODMAP Fermentation)
whyItWorks: 100% red lentil flour pasta packs 9g of legume fiber and high oligosaccharide concentrations per serving. Triggers severe osmotic diarrhea, rapid gas distension, and tenesmus in active IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid red lentil and legume-based pastas. Opt for low-residue white rice noodles or enriched white semolina.
